newsitem.title: USA: U.S. funds shows inflow for 2-day period - survey.
newsitem.headline: U.S. funds shows inflow for 2-day period - survey.

text.p: U.S. mutual funds recorded a strong inflow of $839 million for the two-day period ended Oct 21, versus an outflow of $157 million for the previous three-day period ended Oct 17, according to Mutual Fund Trim Tabs.
The fund tracker said that U.S. stock funds posted inflows of $549 million versus outflows of $23 million, while international funds had inflows of $290 million versus outflows of $134 million.

Aggressive growth funds posted inflows of $102 million versus outflows of $80 million, growth and income funds had inflows of $220 million versus inflows of $258 million, and equity income funds had inflows of $92 million versus outflows of $71 million.

Bond funds had inflows for the two-day period of $242 million versus outflows of $117 million. Muni funds had inflows of $231 million versus outflows of $125 million, while government/GNMA funds had outflows of $26 million versus outflows of $43 million.
